trigger.cause: The historical strong-Agent command used --ephemeral. Its public trajectory retained a thread id, but Codex intentionally retained no forkable rollout.

amendment.C0: For each already selected project, generate a fresh C0 with the persistent strong-Agent runner and stop after generation. The only retention change is removal of Codex --ephemeral so the completed active session can be forked.
amendment.online_replay: Execute the fresh C0 through the preregistered official-path candidate executor. Retry only recognized infrastructure censoring.
amendment.branches: Immediately fork C1 and T from the same fresh completed C0 rollout after a valid online replay. No historical transcript reconstruction or independent replacement session is allowed.
amendment.fresh_C0_pass: Still run both matched branches and all postepisode arms. Analyze pass retention as secondary evidence; it cannot count as a replay-caused repair chain.
amendment.fresh_C0_generation_failure: Apply the same predeclared infrastructure censoring rule. Do not substitute another project.

scientific_reason: Native same-session continuity is the treatment substrate. Reconstructing a session from logs or using independent continuations would destroy the matched-prefix causal contrast.
safeguard_note: This amendment records an execution-feasibility correction, not a runtime gate or software contract.
